|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">ビス人男性。ミュージシャンで、モス・アイズリーの酒場のバンド、フィグリン・ダン・アンド・モーダル・ノーズを率いる。ギャンブラーで、いかさま師。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Figrin D'an.

'''Card text:''' During your control phase each turn, you may use 1 Force to gamble. Draw three destinies, and your opponent draws two. The player with the higher total may retrieve one random card from their Lost Pile.

'''Lore:''' A male Bith musician who leads Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes, the band at the Mos Eisley cantina. A gambler and cheat.
